title: Remove nonexistent operations from the API discovery endpoint
prompt:
Correct the API discovery document so clients do not attempt unavailable operations; work on the assigned branch you are on. The only production file to change is apps/web/src/app/api/v1/route.ts. apps/web/src/app/api/v1/route.ts:19-21 advertises POST /api/v1/freeze, POST /api/v1/unfreeze, and GET /api/v1/audit as available endpoints. The repository has no route.ts handlers for any of those paths. Local execution of the discovery GET and filesystem checks confirmed all three mismatches. README.md also lists freeze and audit, but implementing them would exceed this job's scope.

Remove those three entries from the endpoints object. Preserve all currently implemented endpoint descriptions, the version, and the response structure. This change addresses the machine-readable discovery surface only; do not implement freeze, unfreeze, audit, or change authentication metadata. Do not modify the homepage or README, which are outside this job's production-file boundary.

Add tests/api/discovery-routes.test.mjs. Execute the real GET with a minimal NextResponse.json stub using the existing TypeScript-stripping test approach. Assert the three absent operations are not advertised, expected existing operations remain, and each advertised method/path resolves to a route file exporting that method. Perform only filesystem inspection and stubbed handler execution, without network calls. Run node --test tests/api/discovery-routes.test.mjs and node --test tests/security/*.test.mjs. No credentials, payments, sends, deployments, migrations, .github/workflows, package.json or auth changes. Do not commit or push.
